sources.snippet: This model is free for a limited time on PAYG! Kimi K3 is Kimi's most capable model to date, with 2.8 trillion parameters. Built on Kimi Delta Attention, a hybrid linear attention mechanism, and Attention Residuals, it offers native visual understanding and a 1M-token context window for frontier intelligence scenarios such as software engineering, knowledge work, and deep reasoning.
